feedbackEn: There the whole (3) was swapped with the numerator (1). That would be 3 1/4.

label: 1 queque entero y 3 trozos de otro cortado en 3 partes
feedback: 3 trozos de 3 son otro queque entero: eso sería 2.
feedbackEn: 3 pieces of 3 make another whole cake: that would be 2.

label: 1 queque cortado en 4 trozos y se usan 3
feedback: Eso es solo 3/4. Falta el queque entero.
feedbackEn: That's only 3/4. The whole cake is missing.

label: Entre 2 y 3
feedback: Correcto: 11/4 = 2 3/4: está después del 2 y antes del 3.
feedbackEn: That's right: 11/4 = 2 3/4: it's past 2 and before 3.

label: Entre 11 y 4
feedback: 11/4 no es un número entre 11 y 4: son 11 cuartos.
feedbackEn: 11/4 isn't a number between 11 and 4: it's 11 fourths.

label: Entre 0 y 1
feedback: 11/4 es impropia: el numerador es mayor, así que es más que un entero.
feedbackEn: 11/4 is improper: the numerator is greater, so it's more than one whole.

label: Entre 3 y 4
feedback: En 11 cuartos caben 2 enteros (8 cuartos), no 3 (12 cuartos).
feedbackEn: 2 wholes (8 fourths) fit in 11 fourths, not 3 (12 fourths).

label: No: 5/3 es más que un entero (1 2/3)
feedback: Correcto: 5 tercios son 3 tercios (1 entero) y 2 más: 1 2/3, más que 1.
feedbackEn: That's right: 5 thirds is 3 thirds (1 whole) plus 2 more: 1 2/3, more than 1.

label: Sí: las fracciones siempre son menores que 1
feedback: Las fracciones impropias, como 5/3, son mayores o iguales que 1.
feedbackEn: Improper fractions, like 5/3, are greater than or equal to 1.

label: Sí: 5/3 es lo mismo que 3/5
feedback: 5/3 y 3/5 no son lo mismo: el orden importa.
feedbackEn: 5/3 and 3/5 aren't the same: the order matters.

label: No: 5/3 es igual a 1
feedback: 1 entero son 3/3. 5/3 tiene 2 tercios más.
feedbackEn: 1 whole is 3/3. 5/3 has 2 more thirds.

label: Ignacio

feedbackEn: That's right: 2 wholes = 10/5, and 10/5 + 3/5 = 13/5. Fernanda just put the digits together.

label: Fernanda
feedback: Fernanda juntó los dígitos 2 y 3. Los 2 enteros son 10 quintos.
feedbackEn: Fernanda put the digits 2 and 3 together. The 2 wholes are 10 fifths.

label: Los dos
feedback: 23/5 y 13/5 no son iguales. Solo uno convirtió bien.
feedbackEn: 23/5 and 13/5 aren't equal. Only one converted correctly.

label: Ninguno
feedback: Revisa lo de Ignacio: 2 × 5 + 3 = 13. Está bien.
feedbackEn: Check Ignacio's work: 2 × 5 + 3 = 13. It's right.

feedback: Correcto: 3 metros = 6 medios, más 1 medio: 7 medios metros (7/2).
feedbackEn: That's right: 3 meters = 6 halves, plus 1 half: 7 half meters (7/2).

feedbackEn: The digits 3 and 1 aren't put together: the 3 meters are 6 halves.

label: 3 botellas y sobra 1/4 L
feedback: Correcto: 13/4 = 3 1/4: llena 3 botellas y sobra 1/4 de litro.
feedbackEn: That's right: 13/4 = 3 1/4: she fills 3 bottles and 1/4 liter is left.

label: 13 botellas
feedback: Cada vaso es 1/4 de litro, no un litro. Hacen falta 4 vasos por botella.
feedbackEn: Each glass is 1/4 liter, not one liter. It takes 4 glasses per bottle.

label: 3 botellas y sobra 1/13 L
feedback: Lo que sobra es 1 vaso de 1/4 de litro: el denominador es 4.
feedbackEn: What's left is 1 glass of 1/4 liter: the denominator is 4.

label: 4 botellas y sobra 1/4 L
feedback: Para 4 botellas harían falta 16 vasos. Con 13 alcanza para 3.
feedbackEn: 4 bottles would need 16 glasses. 13 is enough for 3.

feedback: Correcto: 4 enteros = 4 × 3 = 12 tercios: 12/3.
feedbackEn: That's right: 4 wholes = 4 × 3 = 12 thirds: 12/3.

feedback: 4/12 es menos que un entero. Revisa el orden: 12 tercios es 12/3.
feedbackEn: 4/12 is less than one whole. Check the order: 12 thirds is 12/3.

feedback: Se sumó 4 + 3. Cada entero son 3 tercios: multiplica.
feedbackEn: 4 + 3 was added. Each whole is 3 thirds: multiply.

feedback: Revisa la multiplicación: 4 × 3 = 12, no 16.
feedbackEn: Check the multiplication: 4 × 3 = 12, not 16.

feedback: Correcto: 1 entero y 3/5: 1 3/5, que son 5 + 3 = 8 quintos.
feedbackEn: That's right: 1 whole and 3/5: 1 3/5, which is 5 + 3 = 8 fifths.

feedback: El entero no vale 1 quinto: vale 5 quintos.
feedbackEn: The whole isn't worth 1 fifth: it's worth 5 fifths.

feedback: No se juntan los dígitos: el entero son 5 quintos.

label: Sí: su numerador es mayor o igual que su denominador
feedback: Correcto: si el numerador es mayor o igual, hay al menos un entero completo.
feedbackEn: That's right: if the numerator is greater or equal, there's at least one full whole.

label: No: 3/5 es impropia y es menor que 1
feedback: 3/5 no es impropia: su numerador es menor. Es propia.
feedbackEn: 3/5 isn't improper: its numerator is smaller. It's proper.

label: No: las impropias siempre son menores que 1
feedback: Es al revés: las propias son menores que 1; las impropias, mayores o iguales.
feedbackEn: It's the opposite: proper fractions are less than 1; improper ones are greater or equal.

label: No: 4/4 es impropia y es menor que 1
feedback: 4/4 sí es impropia, pero no es menor que 1: 4 cuartos son justo 1 entero. Por eso se dice «mayor o igual».
feedbackEn: 4/4 is improper, but it isn't less than 1: 4 fourths is exactly 1 whole. That's why it says "greater than or equal".

feedback: Correcto: a mitad de camino entre 2 y 3 está 2 + 1/2 = 2 1/2.
feedbackEn: That's right: halfway between 2 and 3 is 2 + 1/2 = 2 1/2.

feedbackEn: 1/3 isn't half. Half is 1/2.
